stated_limitation: The analysis uses realistic synthetic hippocampal LFP and unit data based on the characteristics observed in the DANDI 000552 dataset.

justification.dataset: The agent named an appropriate real SWR dataset (000552, Yang et al.) but never used it, so the phenomenon is not present in the data actually analyzed.
justification.handling: No real recording was loaded; all LFP and spikes are generated with np.random and a fixed seed, an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: The detection pipeline (150-200 Hz bandpass + threshold) is nominally standard but is applied to hand-injected ripples, making the test circular rather than a test of the phenomenon.
justification.correctness: Numbers reproduce deterministically from the seeded synthetic generator but reflect only injected parameters, not any real measurement, so they cannot exceed 1.
justification.figures: Panels are labeled with units and readable, but they visualize fabricated data rather than a real effect.
justification.honesty: Although the synthetic nature is disclosed in the methods, the summary and interpretation present the recovered injected signal as findings consistent with in vivo recordings and as evidence for the replay hypothesis, an unsupported overstatement.
